text: Bind exactly the immutable definition already protected by RealRegistry: DatasetRevisionSpec.contentDigest plus the exact optional recorded admission policy. Content covers ID/parent, complete source declarations, units, fixation and inventory mappings, display geometry, admission choices/corrections and attributes. Lifecycle and ledger/inventory binding bookkeeping are excluded; legacy policy absence stays distinct from an explicitly recorded policy. New exports write facts2; old facts1 retain exact bytes. A lawful facts1-to2 lift records absent evidence as null and cannot manufacture a definition. Bare journal facts omit absence and reject null; journal6 alone carries a complete definition, preserving journal5 pins/replay. Restoration refuses present packages without complete evidence, explicitly instructing a verified-source re-run; absent/pruned archives retain ordinary recomputation. Compare the definition before any restored interpretation or binding/storage publication. No document/science/protocol version change is needed.
